name: PazaryeriConverter for WooCommerce
author: pazaryericonverterv2

sections.description:
PazaryeriConverter is a marketplace integration platform for merchants selling on Turkish marketplaces. This plugin is the easiest and safest way to connect a WooCommerce store to a PazaryeriConverter account.

PazaryeriConverter connects to your store through the official WooCommerce REST API. The plugin prepares everything that connection needs:

  • Creates a dedicated WooCommerce REST API key for PazaryeriConverter in one click.
  • Immediately tests the key using the same authentication method PazaryeriConverter uses, and explains the result in plain language.
  • Detects the most common problems before they break the connection: missing HTTPS, “Plain” permalinks, WordPress installed in a subdirectory, a changed REST API prefix and security plugins that may block the REST API.
  • Shows when PazaryeriConverter last accessed your store.
  • Lets you disconnect with one click.

Once connected, you can use the PazaryeriConverter dashboard to:

  • Sell on marketplaces: send your WooCommerce products to Trendyol, Hepsiburada, N11, Çiçeksepeti, Pazarama, PttAVM, Ozon, İdefix and other marketplaces in bulk.
  • Synchronize products: simple and variable products are imported with their images, categories, brands and attributes. Products from your marketplace stores can also be added to WooCommerce.
  • Synchronize stock and prices: marketplace sales are reflected in your WooCommerce stock, and prices can be updated per channel in bulk.
  • Manage orders: WooCommerce orders are listed together with your marketplace orders on a single screen and can be invoiced from there.

Product, stock, price and order synchronization is performed by the PazaryeriConverter service. This plugin does not modify your WooCommerce products, orders or customers; it only creates, tests and manages the connection.

The plugin interface is in Turkish.

Features

  • One-click WooCommerce REST API key (read/write) dedicated to PazaryeriConverter
  • Instant verification of the key with the authentication method PazaryeriConverter uses
  • The consumer secret is displayed only once and is never stored in the plugin settings
  • Connection status: key, last access by PazaryeriConverter, last test result
  • System check: HTTPS, permalinks, REST API URL, REST API reachability, security plugins
  • One-click disconnect
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the block-based checkout

Supported Marketplaces

Through PazaryeriConverter you can manage your WooCommerce store together with:

  • Trendyol
  • Hepsiburada
  • N11
  • Çiçeksepeti
  • Pazarama
  • PttAVM
  • Ozon
  • İdefix
  • Amazon Turkey

For the current list see pazaryericonverter.com/entegrasyonlar.

External Services

This plugin is an interface to an external service, PazaryeriConverter (https://pazaryericonverter.com/), provided by PazaryeriConverter Yazılım Ticaret A.Ş. The service integrates your WooCommerce store with online marketplaces.

The plugin itself does not send any data to PazaryeriConverter servers. The only HTTP requests the plugin makes are to your own site’s REST API, to test the connection.

After you enter the connection details in the PazaryeriConverter dashboard, PazaryeriConverter servers connect to your store through the WooCommerce REST API (wc/v3) and read:

  • Products and variations: product ID, name, description, SKU, price, stock, image URLs, categories, brand (WooCommerce Brands) and attributes (such as color or size)
  • Product categories and product attributes with their terms
  • Orders: order number and date, status, currency, totals and discount, line items (product name, quantity, price, tax), customer first and last name, email address, billing and shipping address (country, state, city, address line)

PazaryeriConverter writes to your store:

  • Products and variations you choose to import from marketplaces (new products)
  • Product attributes and attribute terms
  • Stock and price updates for products and variations

This data exchange is required to list your products on marketplaces, keep stock and prices in sync across channels, and manage and invoice your orders from one dashboard. PazaryeriConverter does not modify your WooCommerce orders.

  • Service: https://pazaryericonverter.com/
  • Terms of service: https://pazaryericonverter.com/kurumsal/hizmet-sozlesmesi
  • Privacy policy: https://pazaryericonverter.com/kurumsal/gizlilik-guvenlik

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect data from your visitors, does not set cookies and does not send any data to third parties.

The plugin stores only the following in your WordPress database: the ID of the WooCommerce API key it created and the result of the last connection tests (status and error description). The consumer secret is not stored in the plugin settings; when a key is created it is kept temporarily for at most 10 minutes so it can be displayed once, and it is deleted after being displayed. No API key, password or customer data is written to these records.

When you enter the connection details in the PazaryeriConverter dashboard, the store data listed under “External Services” above (including customer names, email and address information) is processed by PazaryeriConverter. We recommend mentioning this in your store’s privacy policy. For PazaryeriConverter’s data processing terms see https://pazaryericonverter.com/kurumsal/gizlilik-guvenlik
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins > Add New by searching for “PazaryeriConverter”, then activate it. WooCommerce must be installed and active.
  2. Open PazaryeriConverter > Sistem Kontrolü (System Check) and make sure no item is marked as a problem.
  3. On PazaryeriConverter > Bağlantı (Connection), click “Bağlantı Anahtarı Oluştur” (Create Connection Key).
  4. Log in to the PazaryeriConverter dashboard and enter the displayed Web Site, ConsumerKey and SecretKey values in the WooCommerce fields on your profile page.
  5. Start importing your products and sending them to marketplaces from the PazaryeriConverter dashboard.

If you do not have a PazaryeriConverter account yet, you can start with a 7-day free trial.
sections.faq:
Do I need a PazaryeriConverter account?

Yes. This plugin connects your WooCommerce store to your PazaryeriConverter account. Synchronization is managed from the PazaryeriConverter dashboard.

Does synchronization stop if I remove the plugin?

No. PazaryeriConverter connects to your store with a WooCommerce REST API key; deactivating or deleting the plugin does not delete that key. To disconnect, click “Bağlantıyı Kaldır” (Disconnect) on the Connection screen before deleting the plugin, or revoke the key under WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API.

Why is HTTPS required?

PazaryeriConverter authenticates by sending the API key in the request URL. For security reasons WooCommerce only accepts this authentication method over HTTPS.

My WordPress is installed in a subdirectory (e.g. example.com/shop). Will it work?

PazaryeriConverter currently reaches the REST API at the root of your domain (example.com/wp-json/). If WordPress is installed in a subdirectory, the System Check screen will show it; please contact PazaryeriConverter support in that case.

I get “401” (authentication rejected).

The most common causes are: the site is not served over HTTPS, the server or a security plugin strips query parameters from requests, or the key has been revoked. Follow the suggestions on the System Check screen and create a new key.

I get “403” (access blocked).

Usually a security plugin such as Wordfence, a firewall such as Cloudflare or your hosting provider’s security rules are blocking /wp-json/wc/v3/. Allow access to that path.

Will the plugin delete my products or orders?

No. The plugin never touches your products, orders or customers. When it is deleted it only removes its own settings.

I lost my SecretKey.

For your security the consumer secret is only shown when it is created. Create a new key with “Yeni Anahtar Oluştur” (Create New Key) on the Connection screen and update the values in the PazaryeriConverter dashboard; the old key is revoked automatically.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Admin notices after an action are now stored per user instead of being passed in the URL, so the plugin no longer reads any request parameters outside nonce-verified form handlers.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: one-click WooCommerce REST API key creation and verification, connection status, system check, disconnect.
